qa: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait and 1 Tamer card with inherited effects among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [On Deletion] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand without paying the cost.
